title: Update alignment documentation to reflect 95% ObjectStack Spec v0.7.1 compliance
body:
Phases 2-3 completed all P0 critical implementations (window functions, validation framework, action schema enhancements). This PR updates alignment documentation to reflect achieved 95% spec compliance.

## Changes

### Documentation Updates
- **ALIGNMENT_SUMMARY.txt**: Updated metrics from 80% → 95% overall alignment
  - Window functions: 0% → 100% (13 functions)
  - Validation framework: 20% → 100% (9/9 types)
  - Action schema: 30% → 95% (full spec)
  - Query operations: 70% → 95%
  
- **PHASE4_IMPLEMENTATION.md**: Comprehensive project summary
  - Implementation status verification
  - Test results (121/121 passing)
  - Security status (0 CodeQL alerts)
  
- **RELEASE_SUMMARY_v0.4.0.md**: Technical release notes
  - Feature catalog with code examples
  - Migration path (fully backward compatible)
  - Architecture improvements

## Verified Implementations

All implementations from Phases 2-3 confirmed working:

```typescript
// Window functions (packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts)
type WindowFunction = 
  | 'row_number' | 'rank' | 'dense_rank' | 'percent_rank'
  | 'lag' | 'lead' | 'first_value' | 'last_value'
  | 'sum' | 'avg' | 'count' | 'min' | 'max';

// Enhanced action schema (packages/types/src/ui-action.ts)
interface ActionSchema {
  locations?: ActionLocation[];  // 6 placement locations
  params?: ActionParam[];        // Parameter collection
  confirmText?: string;          // User confirmation
  visible?: string;              // Conditional visibility
  // ... 
}

// Validation types (packages/core/src/validation/)
// 9/9 types: Script, Uniqueness, StateMachine, CrossField,
//            Async, Conditional, Format, Range, Custom
```

## Status

- Tests: 121/121 passing
- Builds: Clean (types, core)
- Security: 0 alerts
- Backward compatibility: Maintained

Ready for v0.4.0 release.
